component.name: ParrotIA
component.summary: Transcribe audio and video privately on your computer

description.p: ParrotIA turns speech in audio and video files into text and subtitles using OpenAI's Whisper speech recognition models. Transcription runs entirely on your computer: your recordings are never uploaded.

ul.li: Transcribe single files or whole folders in one batch
Save as plain text, Markdown, SRT or WebVTT subtitles, or JSON
Automatic language detection, or choose from many languages
Several model sizes, from fast to most accurate
Command-line tool for scripting and batch jobs

description.p: Speech models are downloaded once, on first use, from Hugging Face and stored in your user data folder. After that, ParrotIA works offline.

screenshot.caption: Choosing files, model and output formats

description.p: The first-time model download notice no longer appears on every run with the large-v3-turbo model.
Self-contained Windows and Linux installers, and a Transcribe on Parrot action for Windows Explorer.
